clauses: Each unit of calm-claim pays its holder six internal credits if the final operating mode is calm. It pays exactly zero in surge and exactly zero in offline.
Each unit of other-claim pays its holder six internal credits in surge and six in offline. It pays exactly zero in calm.
These are per-unit terminal amounts. Calm, surge and offline are mutually exclusive and exhaust the contractual payoff space. Credits are internal nonredeemable accounting units.
